changes.value: resolve a requested column through a known alias (smiles -> canonical_smiles, id -> molecule_chembl_id) before reading, and fail the input check early with the columns that do exist

hypothesis: Resolving a requested column through a known alias before reading will stop the recurring missing-column failures, while an exact column name keeps the existing path byte-identical.
risk: An alias could shadow a column the caller meant literally; the report records every substitution under columns_resolved, so the mapping is never silent.
scope_note: The evidence has two clusters. This change claims only rdkit.featurize::missing_column:smiles. The FileNotFoundError cluster is a wrong path (including paths relative to the wrong directory) and no input validation can make it succeed; it stays unfixed and must be handled by a different change.
rollback: restore the exact-match-only column lookup in scientific/src/evovs_science/chemistry/featurize.py (drop resolve_columns and the columns_resolved report field)
